metadata.question: Was the nighttime brightness over northern part of Isabela Island greater than the southern part of Isabela Island at 1:20 am local time on January 7, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: we need nighttime lights data for 7 Jan 2022, acquired at ~01:20 local time (Galápagos is UTC-6). VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (VNP46A1) provides 15-min granules, so we search the VNP46A1 ImageCollection for 2022-01-07 (entire day) and later filter by the local hour 01:20 (≈ 07:20 UTC). 2. Geometry: northern Isabela ≈ top third of the island (0.2° tall); southern Isabela ≈ bottom third (0.2° tall). Both boxes are 0.4° wide to stay on the island. 3. Masking: VNP46A1 “QF_Cloud_Mask” bit 0–1 =0 means clear; we mask everything else. We also mask land/water using the “land_water_mask” band (value 1 = land). 4. Pixel check: count valid NBTL (Nighttime Lights) pixels in each box; if 0 → C2. 5. Logic: compute mean NBTL in north vs south. If north mean > south mean → A, else B. None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & time north = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(-91.6, 0.5, -91.2, 0.7) # northern Isabela south = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(-91.6, -0.7, -91.2, -0.5) # southern Isabela date = '2022-01-07' # 2. Acquire VIIRS VNP46A1 for that day col = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1') .filterDate(date, date+'T23:59:59') .select(['NBTL', 'QF_Cloud_Mask', 'land_water_mask'])) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print('No VNP46A1 images for 2022-01-07.') print('C1') # 3. Local time 01:20 (Galápagos UTC-6) -> UTC 07:20 targetUtc = 7 + 20/60 def localHour(img): utc = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).get('hour').add( ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).get('minute').divide(60)) return img.set('utc_hour', utc) col = col.map(localHour).filter(ee.Filter.eq('utc_hour', targetUtc)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: print('No granule at ~01:20 local time.') print('C1') img = col.first() # 4. Mask clouds & keep land only clear = img.select('QF_Cloud_Mask').bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0) land = img.select('land_water_mask').eq(1) nbtl = img.select('NBTL').updateMask(clear.And(land)) # 5. Reduce & validate red = lambda geom: nbtl.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9) northMean = red(north).get('NBTL').getInfo() southMean = red(south).get('NBTL').getInfo() northCnt = nbtl.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=north, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get('NBTL').getInfo() southCnt = nbtl.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=south, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get('NBTL').getInfo() if northCnt == 0 or southCnt == 0: print('No valid pixels after masking.') print('C2') print(f'North mean: {northMean:.2f}, South mean: {southMean:.2f}, Pixels N/S: {int(northCnt)}/{int(southCnt)}') if northMean is None or southMean is None: print('C3') elif northMean > southMean: print('A') else: print('B') ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & time
north = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(-91.6, 0.5, -91.2, 0.7)   # northern Isabela
south = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(-91.6, -0.7, -91.2, -0.5) # southern Isabela
date = '2022-01-07'

# 2. Acquire VIIRS VNP46A1 for that day
col = (ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/VNP46A1')
         .filterDate(date, date+'T23:59:59')
         .select(['NBTL', 'QF_Cloud_Mask', 'land_water_mask']))

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print('No VNP46A1 images for 2022-01-07.')
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')

# 3. Local time 01:20 (Galápagos UTC-6) -> UTC 07:20
targetUtc = 7 + 20/60
def localHour(img):
    utc = ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).get('hour').add(
          ee.Date(img.get('system:time_start')).get('minute').divide(60))
    return img.set('utc_hour', utc)
col = col.map(localHour).filter(ee.Filter.eq('utc_hour', targetUtc))

if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print('No granule at ~01:20 local time.')
    print('<answer>C1</answer>')

img = col.first()

# 4. Mask clouds & keep land only
clear = img.select('QF_Cloud_Mask').bitwiseAnd(3).eq(0)
land = img.select('land_water_mask').eq(1)
nbtl = img.select('NBTL').updateMask(clear.And(land))

# 5. Reduce & validate
red = lambda geom: nbtl.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=geom, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9)
northMean = red(north).get('NBTL').getInfo()
southMean = red(south).get('NBTL').getInfo()
northCnt = nbtl.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=north, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get('NBTL').getInfo()
southCnt = nbtl.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=south, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9).get('NBTL').getInfo()

if northCnt == 0 or southCnt == 0:
    print('No valid pixels after masking.')
    print('<answer>C2</answer>')

print(f'North mean: {northMean:.2f}, South mean: {southMean:.2f}, Pixels N/S: {int(northCnt)}/{int(southCnt)}')

if northMean is None or southMean is None:
    print('<answer>C3</answer>')
elif northMean > southMean:
    print('<answer>A</answer>')
else:
    print('<answer>B</answer>')
